The single source of truth for humans and coding agents (Copilot, Claude,
Cursor, Hermes, etc.) working on Trishula — [
  `AGENTS.md`
](https://github.com/trishula-dev/trishula/blob/main/AGENTS.md) in the
[`trishula`](https://github.com/trishula-dev/trishula) repository.
Tool-specific files (`CLAUDE.md`, `.github/copilot-instructions.md`) point
there; when anything disagrees, **AGENTS.md wins**.

This page is a **verbatim render** of that file; the synced copy lives at
[`includes/AGENTS.md`](https://github.com/trishula-dev/trishula-website/blob/main/includes/AGENTS.md)
(resync = `curl -o includes/AGENTS.md https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trishula-dev/trishula/main/AGENTS.md`).
